questions.solution:
Given, equation of curve is
$y=x^{2}-x+4$
Slope of tangent at $P(1,4)$ is
$\frac{d y}{d x}=2 x-1 \Rightarrow\left(\frac{d y}{d x}\right)_{(1,4)}=2-1=1$
So, equation of tangent is
$y-4=1(x-1)\Rightarrow \quad y-x=3...(i)$
and cquation of normal at point $P(1,4)$ is
$\begin{aligned}
&y-4=-1(x-1) \\
&x+y=5 ...(ii)
\end{aligned}$
Since, the tangent cuts $X$-axis at $A$.
Therefore, coordinates of $A$ are $(-3,0)$ and the normal cuts $X$-axis at $B$ and coordinates of $B$ are $(5,0)$.
Therefore, area of $\triangle P A B=\frac{1}{2}\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 4 & 1 \\ -3 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right|=\frac{1}{2}[1(0)-4(-3-5)+1(0)]=\frac{1}{2}|32|=16$ sq. units

From lens Maker's formula,
$\begin{aligned} & \frac{1}{f}=\left(\mu_{g}-1\right)\left(\frac{1}{R_{1}}-\frac{1}{R_{2}}\right) \\ \Rightarrow \quad & \frac{1}{R_{1}}-\frac{1}{R_{2}}=\frac{1}{f\left(\mu_{g}-1\right)}...(i) \end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}

&=\left(\frac{\mu_{g}}{\mu_{w}}-1\right) \frac{1}{f\left(\mu_{g}-1\right)} \quad \text { [using Eq. (i)] } \\
\frac{f}{f^{\prime}} &=\left(\frac{15}{4 / 3}-1\right) \times \frac{1}{(15-1)} \\
&=\left(\frac{9}{8}-1\right) \times 2=\frac{1}{4} \\
f^{\prime} &=4 f \text { or } f^{\prime} \gt f
\end{aligned}\therefore$ The focal length of lens is greater than $f$ in water.

questions.solution:
The efficiency of a Carnot engine is given by

Given, $\quad T_{1}=627^{\circ} \mathrm{C}=627+273=900 \mathrm{~K}$
and $\quad T_{2}=27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}=27+273=300 \mathrm{~K}\Rightarrow \quad \eta=1-\frac{300}{900}=\frac{600}{900}=\frac{2}{3}$

$=\frac{2}{3} \times 300=200 \mathrm{~J}$
